trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Lydia: The water under these cliffs is warmer than it looks. The volcano heats it! Come on in!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Lydia: Brr. Losing takes the warmth right out of it.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Graham: One good punch settles most things. My Pokémon have been practising theirs all week!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Graham: Out for the count. Fair and square.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Bird Keeper Geneva: My Xatu stared at the horizon all morning and wouldn't say why. Then you turned up!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Bird Keeper Geneva: So that's what it saw coming. It might have warned me.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Dragon Tamer Stanley: A little Dratini today, a mighty dragon tomorrow. Help me hurry it along!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Dragon Tamer Stanley: Tomorrow's a while off yet, it seems.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Wade: I swim with a shoal of Carvanha. They've only bitten me twice! Want to meet them?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Wade: Make that three times. They always sulk when we lose.
